text:
In the first scene, I find myself gazing through glass at a group gathered in conversation or perhaps a collaborative meeting. There is an air of anticipation and engagement within the room, though I remain just outside, separated from their exchange. It stirs in me a quiet feeling of curiosity and perhaps a touch of longing to join, to be part of their purposeful collective.

The second scene immerses me in vibrant visuals and bold text on the wall—R+D, standing for research and development. The colors and design invigorate my senses. I feel intellectually stimulated, surrounded by ideas and innovation. There is promise here: the promise of new knowledge forming, of boundaries being explored. I feel inspired, aware of the vast potential of human creativity.
